name: Fine Arts Museum
kicker: The yellow mansion on Phó Đức Chính
summary: Yellow mansion museum on Phó Đức Chính: walk the galleries 08:00–17:00 for the art collection. The homepage prints 60,000 đồng a visit at 97 Phó Đức Chính, Phường Bến Thành. The ticket page prints 30,000 đồng for an adult at 97A, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình. Both addresses and both prices stay until the desk confirms one.

notice.body: The homepage prints 60,000 đồng a visit. The ticket page prints 30,000 đồng for an adult, 15,000 đồng for a student, and free for a child under 6 and a visitor over 60. Ask which tariff the desk is using.

body: The museum is the yellow mansion on Phó Đức Chính. The homepage gives 97 Phó Đức Chính, Phường Bến Thành, and 60,000 đồng a visit. The ticket page gives 97A Phó Đức Chính, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1, with an adult at 30,000 đồng, a student or pupil at 15,000 đồng, and free entry for a child under 6 and a visitor over 60. Hours on both pages are 08:00–17:00, Monday through Sunday. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 3.9 km. From Bạch Đằng it is about 1.8 km.

The city itinerary puts the mansion on a Sunday afternoon with the War Remnants Museum. Leave bulky bags in the lockers. Phones may take commemorative pictures, and flash is not allowed. Food and drink stay out of the galleries. The photograph is the facade and the gate. The second frame is the stair and the stained glass looking onto the yellow courtyard.

gettingThere: The two addresses on the museum site are 97 Phó Đức Chính, Phường Bến Thành, and 97A Phó Đức Chính, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình. From Bạch Đằng the waterbus station page prints about 1.8 km. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 3.9 km.

admissionNote: Homepage: 60,000 đồng a visit, at 97 Phó Đức Chính, Phường Bến Thành. Ticket page: adult 30,000 đồng, pupil or student 15,000 đồng, free for a child under 6 and a visitor over 60, at 97A Phó Đức Chính, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình. Both prices and both addresses stay. Show papers for a free or reduced ticket. The History Museum’s 17 September 2026 notice cites Resolution 29/2026/NQ-HĐND of 27 August 2026 for a 60,000 đồng museum fee from 1 October 2026. This museum’s homepage already prints 60,000 đồng.
